name: OWASP ASVS Level 1
description: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard v4.0.3 Level 1 — covering architecture (security.txt), session management (cookies), access control, secrets, CSP, SRI, debug leakage, content-type options, and meta headers.

items.description: security.txt must exist for vulnerability reporting (OWASP ASVS 1.14.1 — RFC 9116)
items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 1.14.1 — security.txt per RFC 9116; ISO A.8.16
items.remediation: Create .well-known/security.txt with Contact, Expires, and Preferred-Languages fields per RFC 9116.

items.description: No unprotected sensitive paths (OWASP ASVS 4.1.1 — access control enforcement)
items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 4.1.1 — access controls must be enforced on all protected resources
items.remediation: Remove or protect all admin, debug, and API paths with proper authentication.

items.description: No hardcoded secrets in JavaScript (OWASP ASVS 6.1.2 — no secrets in client-side code)
items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 6.1.2 — no API keys, tokens, passwords in client-side code; ISO A.5.17
items.remediation: Remove all hardcoded API keys, tokens, and passwords from client-side JavaScript files.

items.description: JS cookies must have Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite (OWASP ASVS 3.2 — session management)
items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 3.2.1–3.2.3 — Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite on all cookies
items.remediation: Add Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes to all JavaScript cookie settings.

items.description: No debug or error information in production (OWASP ASVS 7.1.1)
items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 7.1.1 — no debug information, stack traces, or error messages in production
items.remediation: Remove all debug output, error messages, and file paths from production HTML.

items.description: CSP must restrict script sources (OWASP ASVS 14.4.1–14.4.3)
items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 14.4.1 — CSP present; 14.4.2 — no unsafe-inline; 14.4.3 — object-src restricted
items.remediation: Implement CSP with 'self' directives — avoid 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'.

items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 14.5.2 — X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors required
items.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY on all pages to prevent clickjacking.
Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to prevent MIME type sniffing.

items.description: No known-vulnerable CDN libraries (OWASP ASVS 14.4.5 / NIST SI-2)
items.regulation: OWASP ASVS 14.4.5 — SRI for third-party content; NIST SP 800-53 SI-2 — flaw remediation
items.remediation: Update all CDN libraries to current versions. Add SRI integrity hashes.
